Pass observationDate when supplied, informationCutoff default new Date().toISOString(), and snapshotId when supplied to getCompanyCoverage. Validate YYYY-MM-DD calendar day, datetime cutoff and 64-hex snapshot identity before invoking; malformed inputs return 422.

Set Cache-Control: no-store. Return the full report including both populations, separate state counts, known-value coverage, sourceId and limitations. Storage/corruption availability errors return explicit 503, not an empty or zero report.

No generic request-contract changes are required if this route is registered before the global selector middleware. Alternative placement requires deliberate request-policy registration and must avoid indicator/overlay reads and archive mutations.
